The Julian P. Kanter Political Commercial Archive is housed at **The University of Oklahoma (OU)**.  
According to OU’s Fall 2023 Staff Matrix (Institutional Research & Reporting), the university employed **7,983 staff members** (full‑time, part‑time, hourly, and temporary) on its Norman campus.  

So, about **7,983 people work at the school that holds the archive**.
